notes: release 26H1128V2: the editor column follows three hard floors from the measured window -- the note grid takes at least half the window height, the tuning lane at least a fifth, the arrangement strip at least one complete track row (ruler 16dp + row 38dp + 2dp = 56dp). When they do not fit, the strip yields first (it scrolls), then the tuning lane down to its floor, and the log says ROLL_FLOOR_HIT instead of shrinking silently. Measured at 480dpi on 1920x1080: landscape roll 508/1008 px (50.4 pct), tuning 202 px (20.0 pct), strip 168 px; portrait roll 1030/1848 px (55.7 pct); 280dpi roll 653/1038 px (62.9 pct). The top bar stacks into two rows in portrait, where about 480dp of controls did not fit 360dp and the rightmost buttons were clipped. The status line is 9sp single-line in landscape and the strip ruler went 18dp to 16dp, so the note grid gets it all back.
